overview_description.description: Newfront provides business insurance, employee benefits, total rewards, and retirement services through a platform that blends brokerage services with proprietary technology. The company supports organizations by offering solutions for commercial insurance placement, compensation and benefits design, and centralized tools that help manage policies and total rewards programs efficiently. Newfront delivers data-driven insights, digital dashboards, and AI-enabled tools that streamline tasks such as vendor selection, compliance tracking, and coverage analysis. Its offerings aim to help sales development and HR teams assess market trends, optimize risk strategies, and coordinate employee benefit plans. The services integrate real-time information across insurance and rewards programs to support decision-making without focusing on promotional language.

product.name: Navigator for Business Insurance
product.description: A platform providing 24/7 access to business insurance programs including policies, losses, certificates of insurance, and billing on any device.

product.name: Navigator for Total Rewards
product.description: A centralized platform for total rewards clients to access benefit plans, compliance information, and secure documents.

product.name: Advanced Professionals (AP) Insurance & Benefit Solutions
product.description: A wholesale benefits division offering exclusive benefit plans, consulting, and a proprietary platform for associations, producers, carriers, and employers.

product.name: Asset Protection Program (Lender Placed Insurance)
product.description: A technology-powered lender-placed insurance program tailored for financial institutions covering real estate, auto, and equipment loans.

product.name: Cyber Risk Solutions
product.description: Cyber insurance and risk management services including risk assessment, coverage negotiation, and claims consultation for data breach and cyber threats.

product.name: Executive Risk Solutions
product.description: Insurance solutions protecting executives and boards from risks including D&O liability, employment practices, and fiduciary claims.
